notes.title: Hallowlands 1.0.0 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41311227/9d840d57203faf19ee82cc7500361086f62616a4.png[/img]

In this update I finally added Achievements to the game.  I added 38 Achievements to reward you for getting various levels, skill levels, meeting NPCs, and beating bosses in the game.
